facts.text: I attended a digital marketing workshop last week.
The digital marketing workshop speaker was Rachel Lee.
I catch up with Emma, a freelance writer, over lunch today.
Emma is now a potential collaborator for a project I am working on.
I am interested in learning more about Facebook ads.
I want tutorials on how to set up a Facebook ads campaign.
I want tutorials on how to target the right audience for Facebook ads.
I want to learn more about Facebook's Audience Insights tool.
I am interested in learning more about Instagram ads.
Emma mentioned she has seen great results with Instagram ads.
I want tutorials on how to set up an Instagram ad campaign.
I want to learn about Instagram targeting options.
Emma mentioned she had success targeting specific interests and behaviors.
I want to target Instagram ads to people interested in sustainable living.
I want to target Instagram ads to people interested in eco-friendly products.
I want to learn how to use Instagram's automatic targeting feature.
I want to use Instagram automatic targeting to reach people likely to be interested in sustainable living and eco-friendly products.
